abilities.name: Comsat Station
abilities.text: Select one table edge that is not a player's Entry Edge. Until the End of the Round, Enemy Units cannot Deploy from that edge.

abilities.name: Scanner Sweep
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Faction Indicator, they lose HIDDEN Status.
